about: Every page template, the designed block it follows, and how far its redesign has got. Designed fields (block, basis, spec, status, extra_macros, note) are written by the designers; derived fields (reference, allowed_macros, extends, macros, controls) are regenerated by python scripts/check_design_map.py --write. basis: rule = first assignment by template path, to be confirmed page by page; reviewed = assigned by a designer looking at the page; declared = taken from the page's own design-block marker. Port-map fields (tier, page_type, type_changed, original, frame, charts, inhouse_components, confidence, reason) come from the designers' port map; there persona and components replace the path-rule values, and original is the shadcn original the page follows (reference stays the block's reference).
